character.name: Evil Eye Horseshoe
character.description: A protective evil-eye charm: a blue-and-white glass nazar (evil-eye) bead hanging together with a small lucky iron horseshoe, strung on a single cord, used as a traditional protective charm against the evil eye and for good luck. The nazar bead itself naturally has concentric blue/white/black circle patterns like an eye - that is its real design and should stay, but do not add any extra cartoon facial features on top of it (no drawn eyebrows, no mouth, no pupils moving, not anthropomorphized, not a cartoon character). The cord is a twisted natural cotton/jute rope, visibly fibrous and rough-textured, slightly frayed, off-white or beige in color, not a smooth thin line.

style: Classic hand-drawn 2D theatrical cartoon style, expressive exaggerated poses, squash-and-stretch animation aesthetics, bold clean outlines, vintage cel shading, playful slapstick character design.
